gbm_population_evidence.quote: All patients must have a prior histological diagnosis of GBM (WHO grade IV) or molecular features of GBM (per the 6th volume of Central Nervous System Tumors in the 5th edition of the WHO Classification of Tumors).

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1 investigational study to assess the safety and preliminary efficacy of oral gallium maltolate (GaM) in participants with relapsed glioblastoma (GBM).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Oral Gallium Maltolate for the Treatment of Relapsed and Refractory Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Maximum-tolerated dose.: This will be determined from the incidence of dose limiting toxicities at each dosage.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Progression-free survival: This measure is the number of months participants remain free from evidence of disease.

role_evidence.quote: This is a prospective, single-center, single-arm, open-label phase 1 study to determine the antineoplastic activity, safety and tolerance of GaM in participants with relapsed, treatment-refractory GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: oral gallium compound (iron mimetic / metal-based antineoplastic, investigational)

coder_notes: Single drug registered as six dose-level interventions; coded as one agent row. Arms are dose levels of one experimental regimen, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no (more than one arm, none a control). cns5 because eligibility cites WHO CNS 5th edition alongside 'WHO grade IV'. No PK or pharmacodynamic measures registered.
